meta.name: render-apple-notes-chat
meta.description: Assemble an Apple Notes list video ad from a note + end-card JSON — a frame-accurate fake iPhone screen recording of a short list being typed into Apple Notes (character by character, key pops, blinking caret, the note scrolling up as it fills) crossfaded into a checklist end card (the note's picks as ticked rows, real product photos, logo, CTA, in the brand's colours and fonts), with an optional music bed. FREE assembly (Playwright + ffmpeg); the recipe supplies the per-brand note + end card and gates the paid music call to its own capability. The Apple Notes sibling of render-imessage-chat and render-chatgpt-chat. Use for the apple-notes format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一条清单文案和品牌信息,变成手机录屏风格的短视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要批量产出手机风格的短视频广告,又不想真去剪辑
copy.tagline_en: Turn a list note and brand assets into a phone-screen-style short video ad
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need batches of phone-style video ads without editing footage

howto.what: 根据一段笔记和结尾卡 JSON,合成 Apple Notes 风格的假 iPhone 录屏视频:列表逐字打出来、光标闪烁、键盘弹起,再淡入带勾选的清单结尾卡,可加配乐。
howto.when: 当你需要 apple-notes 格式的广告视频,或创意是「某人给自己留的一份清单」时使用。它只按配置绘制,不决定内容。

say.text: 用 apple-notes 格式渲染这支列表广告,配置我写好了
先只出 note-hook.png 和 note-still.png 给我审
把音乐床加进去,重新合成 master

howto.what_en: Turns a note + end-card JSON into an Apple Notes-style fake iPhone screen recording: a short list typed character by character with key pops and a caret, crossfaded into a ticked checklist end card, optional music bed.
howto.when_en: Use it for the apple-notes ad format, or when the creative is a list someone keeps for themselves. The renderer only draws what the config specifies.

say_en.text: Render this list ad in the apple-notes format — my config is ready.
say_en.note: Outputs notes.mp4 and endcard.png from config.json

say_en.text: Give me just the review stills first.
